title: Observability: dashboards + alerts for usage-insights pipeline lag and export failures
creator: Logan Wright
project: In-console usage insights (cost drivers by route)
description:
Goal
Add production-grade dashboards + alerting for the new Usage Insights backend (route/model aggregates + export jobs). This is a GA gate item for rolling out beyond beta orgs.

Background / context
Usage Insights introduces:
- New telemetry dimensions (route + model) and new aggregate jobs (hourly + daily).
- New Insights APIs (top routes, route detail) that will be queried heavily by Console.
- Export job creation + download flow that can fail under load or due to oversized exports.

We need a single “backend health” Grafana dashboard + actionable alerts with links to runbooks.

References
- Confluence dashboard spec: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/usage-insights-backend-health-dashboards.json
- SLOs: sources/confluence/eng-sre/slo-and-error-budgets/usage-insights-apis-slo.json
- Backfill/recompute runbook (for context + remediation links): sources/confluence/eng-infra/runbooks/backfill-and-recompute-usage-insights-aggregates.json
- Export audit events (for troubleshooting signals): sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/usage-report-export-audit-events.json

Scope
1) Grafana dashboards (observability-pack)
A. Pipeline / Aggregations health
- Ingest lag (event-time -> processed-time) for metering events feeding usage-insights.
- Aggregate job latency (hourly + daily): start delay, runtime, success/fail.
- “Data freshness” indicator: newest fully-aggregated hour and newest fully-aggregated day per deployment mode.
- Late-arrival rate (events arriving > X minutes late) to explain UI deltas and invoice mismatch questions.
- Cardinality guardrail signals (top-N route cardinality, dropped/hashed route counts, “unknown route” rate).

B. Insights API health (top routes / route detail)
- Request rate, error rate, and p50/p95/p99 latency by endpoint.
- DB query time vs application time (where available), cache hit rate for route detail.
- Rate limit / query cost rejections (we need a panel that makes it obvious when customers hit limits).

C. Export job health
- Export job create requests, success/failure, and p95 job end-to-end duration.
- Queue depth / oldest job age.
- Download success/failure + 4xx/5xx breakdown.
- Timeout and “file too large” rejections (should correlate with size limit guardrails).

2) Alerting
We should align thresholds to SLO doc; alerts must be actionable and link to runbook / playbook.

Proposed alert rules (draft)
Pipeline freshness / lag
- WARN: usage_insights_pipeline_lag_p95 > 10m for 10m
- CRIT: usage_insights_pipeline_lag_p95 > 20m for 10m
- CRIT: hourly_aggregate_job_success == 0 for 2 consecutive runs (per region)

Export reliability
- WARN: export_jobs_failure_rate > 2% over 15m (min 50 jobs)
- CRIT: export_jobs_failure_rate > 5% over 15m (min 50 jobs)
- WARN: export_queue_oldest_age > 5m for 10m
- CRIT: export_queue_oldest_age > 15m for 10m
- WARN: export_job_duration_p95 > 120s over 30m

API health (console-facing)
- WARN: insights_api_5xx_rate > 1% over 10m (min 500 req)
- CRIT: insights_api_5xx_rate > 3% over 10m (min 500 req)
- WARN: insights_api_p95_latency > 2.0s over 10m (top routes endpoint)
- CRIT: insights_api_p95_latency > 4.0s over 10m (top routes endpoint)

Cardinality / data quality
- WARN: unknown_route_fraction > 10% over 1h (per org tier optional)
- WARN: route_cardinality_dropped_count > 0 (spiky) over 15m

Notes
- Use multi-window / burn-rate style where feasible for the API SLO alerts.
- Avoid paging on “unknown route” unless it indicates regression (likely customer config); should be Slack-only notification.

Deliverables
- Grafana dashboard(s) merged into observability-pack and deployed to prod.
- Alert rules merged and wired to oncall routing:
  - CRIT -> paging (SRE oncall)
  - WARN -> #eng-sre / #eng-platform channel
- Each alert includes:
  - What broke
  - Impact (UI stale data / exports failing)
  - First steps
  - Links: relevant runbook + dashboard anchor link

Acceptance criteria
- A new Grafana dashboard exists: “Usage Insights / Backend Health”.
- Oncall can answer in <5 minutes:
  1) Is data stale due to ingest lag or aggregation job failure?
  2) Are exports failing because of timeouts/limits vs infrastructure issues?
  3) Are Insights API issues driven by DB, cache, or upstream dependencies?
- Alert rules created with runbook links and have been test-fired in staging.
- Dashboard and alerts reviewed by Telemetry (Logan/Nadia/Mei) and Console backend (Chloe/Jada).

Implementation notes / tasks
- Confirm metric names emitted by services (pipeline, aggregator, export worker, API) and add missing metrics if needed.
- Add labels: region, deployment_mode (hosted/dedicated/private), env (prod/staging).
- For export failures, break down by failure reason (timeout, size_limit, RBAC, internal_error) if we have structured codes.
- Ensure dashboards avoid high-cardinality dimensions (do not graph by raw route; use top-N panels only).

Open questions
- Do we page for aggregate job failure in a single region if other regions are healthy? (likely yes if region supports active customers; need mapping.)
- Should export duration thresholds differ by Dedicated vs Hosted? (Dedicated customers may request larger time ranges; but we also enforce hard limits.)

Rollout plan
- Stage: deploy dashboard + alerts, run synthetic export tests with large-ish dataset.
- Beta prod orgs: enable alerts in “notify-only” for 48h to tune.
- GA: switch CRIT alerts to paging and add to GA gating checklist.
